# OECD Government at a Glance 2025: satisfaction with public services

The OECD's *Government at a Glance 2025* indicators include the share of
people satisfied with the healthcare system, the education system and
administrative services. The 2023 values come from the OECD Survey on Drivers
of Trust in Public Institutions.
